items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember a remark made. I can’t remember what the remark was, but there was – and The Smothers Brothers, with the frog.

ctx.x: Not really. It’s been a long, long, long time ago. I remember – I think - Diahnne
Diahann Carroll was on one of them. I remember a remark made. I can’t remember what the remark was, but there was – and The Smothers Brothers, with the frog. That was one of my favorite things.
